what: In one cell, three to five photos are stacked like a fan. On hover the outer photos shift outward by one step (22px) and two steps (44px) and the middle one lifts 6px (.55s power3.out, reversed along the same path when the hover ends). On touch devices the fan spreads in .7s when the cell reaches 70% of the screen and folds when scrolled back up.

options.step: Distance each step shifts aside (px), default 22 — outer slides shift two steps
options.lift: Height the center sheet lifts (px), default 6
options.ease: Curve, default power3.out ("0.16,1,0.3,1" The same figures apply too)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: One card of the fan (in order from the left, 3–5 cards) — the fan slot (offset and size) is set by the caller in the outer cell, and this part only adds x and y to this card
